C1160.title: Amazon's €746 Million GDPR Fine Partly Annulled and Requiring Reassessment
C1160.summary: In 2021, Luxembourg's data protection authority CNPD issued a GDPR administrative decision against Amazon Europe Core S.à r.l., imposing a €746 million fine and ordering changes to online behavioural advertising practices. Luxembourg's Administrative Tribunal upheld the decision in 2025. On March 12, 2026, the Administrative Court confirmed several substantive CNPD findings but annulled the fine component because the penalty required reassessment of intent or negligence and proportionality under later CJEU case law, leaving the CNPD to continue handling the matter.
